instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Wealth management advisory serving 400+ high-net-worth families with holistic financial planning, tax optimization, and estate structuring. Blending in-person advisory with a client portal for portfolio tracking. Seeking to enhance client reporting with interactive scenario modeling tools. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: We are 3 months into fundraising conversations with growth equity investors who are conducting deep due diligence on our technology and operations. Their feedback indicates concern about our digital maturity relative to peers. We need to quickly identify and launch 2-3 innovation initiatives that will address these concerns and strengthen our fundraising narrative.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: Client Experience Parity Module (UX/UI Overhaul)
opportunities.rationale: To address competitive threats and improve switching costs, a focused incremental effort to overhaul the client portal interface is crucial. This will modernize the user journey without requiring massive platform re-engineering, directly matching modern FinTech CX expectations.

first_actions: Conduct rapid UX audit of the current client portal workflow.
Develop a phased roadmap for UI/UX design sprints.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 15% increase in client portal engagement/login frequency within Q4.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Tax Scenario Modeling
opportunities.rationale: Given the market defense priority, developing proprietary AI to model complex tax implications for high-net-worth clients represents a radical move. This capability could become a unique value proposition that competitors cannot easily replicate.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated task force focused solely on data engineering and ML pipeline architecture.
Identify and secure partnership with a specialized FinTech AI vendor.
resources_needed: Allocate $50k for cloud compute and initial data acquisition
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful deployment of the predictive model in pilot phase, achieving a 20% accuracy rate compared to human planning.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated 'Digital Defense' steering committee to prioritize innovation pipeline projects.
Initiate a formal RFP process for an external UX firm to quantify the digital maturity gap and define CX parity requirements.
Conduct internal talent mapping exercise to identify critical skills needed for AI/ML integration, addressing the 'talent' barrier.

key_weaknesses: Formal innovation process creates bottlenecks that hinder agile response to market shifts.
Moderate digital maturity (4) places the company at risk of being perceived as outdated by modern clientele and investors.
High dependency on a small leadership team, making it difficult to simultaneously manage operational demands and complex strategic innovation initiatives.
